plain_description: Axolotl lets you fine-tune the best open-source LLMs on your own data — no vendor lock-in, no per-seat fees. Get production-quality custom models using your existing GPU hardware with one-click Docker deployment and built-in support for the latest training techniques. Train faster, cheaper, and keep full control of your intellectual property.
technical_description: Axolotl is an open-source CLI framework for fine-tuning and post-training large language models. Built on PyTorch, it supports full fine-tuning, LoRA/QLoRA, preference tuning (DPO, KTO, ORPO), reinforcement learning (GRPO, GDPO), and quantization (GPTQ, QAT, NVFP4). It integrates with Hugging Face Hub for datasets and models, supports multi-GPU and multi-node training via FSDP1/FSDP2, DeepSpeed, and torchrun, and ships as both a PyPI package and a Docker image. Key capabilities include Flash Attention 2/3/4, multipacking, sequence parallelism, and custom kernel integrations (Liger, Cut Cross Entropy, ScatterMoE, SonicMoE) for maximizing throughput on NVIDIA and AMD GPUs.
title: Axolotl

body: 20+ high-performance LLMs with recipes to pretrain, finetune and deploy at scale.
plain_description: LitGPT gives you a ready-to-use platform for pretraining, finetuning, and deploying 20+ top LLMs at enterprise scale. It provides optimized, proven recipes and full control without abstraction layers — making it fast to go from experiment to production.
technical_description: LitGPT is an open-source framework for pretraining, finetuning, and deploying large language models built on PyTorch and Lightning Fabric. It implements 20+ model architectures from scratch with support for distributed training via FSDP, Flash Attention v2, and quantization at FP4, FP8, FP16, and FP32 precision. The CLI and Python API provide workflows for chat, evaluation, fine-tuning (LoRA, QLoRA, Adapter), and model serving via a REST API endpoint. Training configurations are defined through YAML recipes, with support for custom datasets and multi-node GPU/TPU clusters.
title: LitGPT

body: Unified Efficient Fine-Tuning of 100+ LLMs & VLMs (ACL 2024)
plain_description: LLaMA Factory lets businesses fine-tune 100+ leading open-source AI models without writing code. Use the CLI or Web UI to adapt models like Llama, Qwen, and DeepSeek to your specific domain — no ML expertise required. The bottom line: you get custom AI assistants faster and cheaper than building from scratch.
technical_description: LLaMA Factory is a unified PyTorch-based framework for efficient fine-tuning of large language and vision-language models. It supports 100+ model architectures including Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Gemma, and GLM through a single training interface. The framework implements multiple parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods (LoRA, QLoRA, OFT, DoRA, PiSSA), full-parameter training, and advanced optimizers (GaLore, BAdam, APOLLO, Adam-mini, Muon). It provides a Gradio-based Web UI for zero-code training, an OpenAI-compatible REST API for model serving via vLLM or SGLang backends, and supports distributed training with DeepSpeed and FSDP. Integration includes Hugging Face Transformers, PEFT, TRL, FlashAttention-2, and bitsandbytes for quantization down to 2-bit precision.
title: LLaMA Factory

body: An Easy-to-use, Scalable and High-performance Agentic RL Framework based on Ray (PPO & DAPO & REINFORCE++ &  VLM & TIS & vLLM & Ray & Async  RL)
plain_description: Build better AI assistants that follow instructions, reason effectively, and align with human preferences. OpenRLHF is a production-ready open-source framework that scales reinforcement learning training from human feedback to hundreds of billions of parameters. The bottom line: used by Google, ByteDance, and other leading AI companies to train state-of-the-art language models.
technical_description: OpenRLHF is an open-source RLHF framework built on Ray + vLLM distributed architecture with DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 for memory-efficient training. It implements PPO, REINFORCE++, GRPO, and RLOO algorithms decoupled from a unified agent-based execution pipeline supporting both single-turn and multi-turn training. The framework uses hybrid engine scheduling to colocate models and vLLM inference engines across GPUs, enabling training of models up to 70B+ parameters. Production features include async training, checkpoint recovery, Wandb/TensorBoard logging, LoRA/QLoRA support, VLM training, and SLURM multi-node orchestration.
title: OpenRLHF

plain_description: The big picture: PEFT dramatically cuts the cost of customizing large AI models by fine-tuning only a tiny fraction of parameters instead of the entire model. Here's why it matters: You can adapt massive models like 12B-parameter LLMs on a single consumer GPU, saving gigabytes of memory and compute compared to full fine-tuning. The bottom line: PEFT makes enterprise-grade model customization accessible without expensive infrastructure.
technical_description: PEFT is a Python library that implements parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods for large pretrained models. It wraps Transformers, Diffusers, and other HuggingFace models, applying techniques such as LoRA, prefix tuning, and prompt tuning that train only a small subset of parameters while the base model remains frozen. The library provides get_peft_model() and PeftModel APIs for training and inference, with support for mixed adapter management via add_adapter, load_adapter, and set_adapter methods. Integrates with Accelerate for distributed training across GPUs, TPUs, and Apple Silicon, and supports quantization (QLoRA, 8-bit) for reduced memory footprint. Written in Python, distributed via pip, and includes Docker images for CPU and GPU environments.
title: PEFT

body: Train transformer language models with reinforcement learning.
plain_description: Get better results from your AI models by fine-tuning them with reinforcement learning — the same technique used to train DeepSeek-R1. TRL provides ready-to-use trainers for the most effective alignment methods (DPO, GRPO, SFT) so you don't need a PhD team to do it. Scale from a single GPU to a multi-node cluster with just a few lines of code.
technical_description: TRL is a Python library for post-training transformer language models using reinforcement learning. Built on the Hugging Face Transformers ecosystem, it provides Hugging Face Trainer subclasses implementing SFT, GRPO, DPO, KTO, and reward modeling. The library integrates with Accelerate for distributed training from single GPU to multi-node clusters, supports PEFT/QLoRA for memory-efficient fine-tuning on modest hardware, and includes a CLI for zero-code training runs.
title: TRL

body: Unsloth is a local UI for training and running Gemma 4, Qwen3.6, DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM and other models.
plain_description: The big picture: Unsloth turns your own computer into a private AI studio for training and running large language models—no cloud subscription needed. Here's why it matters: you can fine-tune models 2x faster using 70% less memory, chat with documents and images, and connect to tools like Claude Code through a simple interface. The bottom line: powerful, cost-effective AI that runs entirely on your hardware.
technical_description: Unsloth is a local AI training and inference platform comprising a Python library (unsloth) and a web UI (Unsloth Studio). It provides memory-optimized fine-tuning via LoRA/QLoRA with custom Triton and mathematical kernels, supporting 500+ models including Gemma 4, Qwen3.6, DeepSeek, and Llama variants. Training achieves up to 2x speedup and 70% VRAM reduction through 4-bit quantization, packed attention, and efficient MoE kernels. Unsloth Studio exposes OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible REST APIs (v1/chat/completions, v1/messages) for tool integration and includes a GUI for model search and download, multi-modal chat (text, images, audio, PDFs), data preparation via visual recipe workflows, and model export to GGUF and safetensors. Deployment supports bare-metal install via shell script, Docker container, and Colab notebooks.
title: Unsloth
